risk.screen.description: Screen one Hedera account against the private risk feed

a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1.label: research-1
a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1a1.does: Prices a position, pays for market analysis, then swaps on the one router its mandate names. The proceeds have to come back to this account — the chip reads that address out of the calldata before it signs.

b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2.label: ops-nightly
b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2.does: Buys the cheapest pass over a market snapshot, every night, and stops. It may not trade and may not screen.

c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3.label: watcher
c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3c3.does: Screens counterparties against a private feed and reports which position is riskier. It may not trade, and 0.01 is the most it can spend at once.

9de980aa335df2af27ea4c640c09878ca7d9dd91.label: remote-1
9de980aa335df2af27ea4c640c09878ca7d9dd91.does: Buys one pass over the market, then asks for eight times its ceiling and is refused — by a chip it has no address for.
